scope:
Original non-continuous container dispatcher8032c2a0.

Executes global/per-object history lookup, original selection kernels, C RNG,
missing-child retries and resource-index lookup. Existing histories, playlist
storage and loaded resource-index entries are supplied; allocation is not run.
Mutex/memset and caller resource-release bookkeeping are supplied. This is not
Play admission, continuous scheduling, streaming or audio rendering.
